jobs_lease_check.name: jobs_lease_check
jobs_lease_check.value: ("jobs"."status" = 'running' and "jobs"."lease_token" is not null and "jobs"."lease_until" is not null) or ("jobs"."status" <> 'running' and "jobs"."lease_token" is null and "jobs"."lease_until" is null)

review_fields_check.name: review_fields_check
review_fields_check.value: "review_requests"."version" >= 1 and "review_requests"."source_draft_version" >= 1 and length(btrim("review_requests"."title")) > 0 and length(btrim("review_requests"."markdown")) > 0 and char_length("review_requests"."markdown") <= 100000
